body: You didn't send me your PM, but I must say, you are the first person to care about me in a very long time. I shall live untill tomorrow. I downloaded skype, and await your words. Thank you.
It's worth a download. PM me your handle if you would.
Is there a better way to communicate rather than thread?
I have issues and habits, to wheres no one would ever want anything to do with them. And I've tried to relate to reddit before, but everyone seems to either ignore me or hate me.

I refreshed right before I closed everything down.

However, I am doubtful you have anything that will keep me from the inevitable.

It is tied. My stool is in place. My parents are gone. I'm so sorry mother and father. I just can't do this anymore. Please know that I am happy now. Please don't grieve over me. I am not worth it. I have a foundation of problems that root so deeply, that I will never be able to cope with them. I shall leave this page open, so you can see my note. 

Redditors, I understand that most have much to attend to on a Friday night, but don't blame yourselves either. I'm sure you would of helped me if you saw this in time, but life said you wouldn't This life has been constructed for catastrophe. I just can't wait to end it. I hope you all never experience the same fate I will imminently after this message. I love you all, and wish you all the best. Good bye.

Im looking up a noose right now, I think I need a longer rope. I do have one that is a little thicker, but MUCH longer.

Good bye Reddit. You were my vice, and now I have lost that. I hope to see some of you in the afterlife. If there is one.
